constraints: Only works with 4D Server or a single-user application merged with 4D Volume Desktop.

The update is placed 'on hold' in the session until RESTART 4D is called; calling this command several times before that only the last valid call is used, and the setting is not kept if the application is exited manually instead.

When silentErrors is False or omitted, errors are recorded in the update journal and shown in a warning dialog; when True, errors are only recorded in the journal — except if the journal file itself cannot be created, in which case a warning dialog is always shown regardless of silentErrors.
Sets OK to 1 if the command executes correctly, 0 otherwise; errors can be caught with ON ERR CALL.

params.name: folderPath
params.description: Pathname of folder (package under macOS) containing updated application

sentinelValues.meaning: Reset the update information held for the current session.

params.name: silentErrors
params.description: False (default) = report errors visibly, True = do not report them
